subject: Discovery demo for Greenline — quick intake questions + slot options
messages:
From: Emily Turner <emily@greenline.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo inquiry — Greenline Retail

Hi Vanessa,

I signed up through the site and would love a short demo to see how Redwood could help with our customer support summarization and agent assist workflow. Quick context: we run customer support for Greenline Retail (mid-market ecommerce) — ~2M chat interactions/month across web and mobile, peak concurrency ~700 concurrent sessions.

Pilot goal: extract summaries + recommended replies, reduce TTR for agents. Timeline: aiming to start a 6–8 week pilot in early July if everything looks good.

Questions for scheduling: can you share availability next week for a 30-minute demo? Also happy to answer any pre-demo questions that help you tailor the session.

Thanks,
Emily Turner
Head of Support Programs
Greenline Retail
emily@greenline.com
(415) 555-0192
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Redwood demo inquiry — Greenline Retail

Hi Emily — thanks for signing up and for the context, this is helpful. A few quick clarifying questions so we can tailor the demo and prep the right folks on our side: 

- Is the 2M chat count total messages or conversations per month?
- What percent of traffic needs low (sub-200ms) latency vs conversational throughput (we can tune batching if you prioritize cost)?
- Are you planning to host data in cloud or need a private deployment (VPC/on‑prem)?
- Any SOC2/infosec questionnaire we should expect during pilot?
- Do you use SSO (Okta/Azure AD)?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Tue 23 May, 1:00–1:30pm PST
- Wed 24 May, 3:30–4:00pm PST
- Fri 26 May, 2:00–2:30pm PST

I attached a short pre-demo intake template (pre-demo-intake-template.xlsx) — if you can fill the top sheet with traffic numbers (peak sequence lengths, avg tokens per message) that would speed our ops prep.

I'll loop in Priyom (SDR) to help with calendar and Monica (CS) if you want deep product/ops coverage on the call. If afternoons are hard, say so and I can offer morning slots.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Redwood demo inquiry — Greenline Retail

Thanks Vanessa — answers inline: 

- 2M = total messages (both user messages and agent messages). Roughly 450k unique conversations/month.
- Latency: agent assist responses should be under 300ms for UI snappy-ness, summaries can be async (a few seconds ok). About 60% of traffic is low-latency sensitive.
- Cloud preferred (AWS), but we have security requirements and will require a SOC2 report and standard DPA.
- Yes, we have a standard security questionnaire; I can upload it after the call.
- SSO: Yes, Okta.

Afternoons work better — Wed 24 May 3:30–4:00pm PST would be ideal for our PM and ops presenter. I'll upload a short csv with token/sequence estimates — attaching a minimal traffic extract now.

Emily
